prompt: Rendered as a pencil sketch with light color wash, the scene captures a bustling construction site. On the left, a worker in a yellow hard hat stands firmly on the muddy ground. Next to him, a large steel beam rests horizontally, its metallic surface lightly shaded. In the center, a foreman in an orange vest points decisively toward the upper scaffolding. A crane operator in a blue shirt sits inside the cab high above, looking down at the activity below. To the right, a stack of red bricks is piled neatly near the edge of the frame. A stray cat with black fur crouches beside the bricks, watching the workers intently. Near the foreground, a woman in a white helmet holds a rolled-up blueprint tightly against her chest. She is handing a small tool to a colleague in a green jacket who reaches out eagerly. Behind them, a cement mixer with a rotating drum churns slowly, adding dynamic motion to the static structures. A wooden ladder leans precariously against the unfinished wall on the far right. There is no heavy machinery smoke obscuring the view. There is no bright sunlight casting harsh shadows.
